note: Jamaica: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 180 days (the Dominican Republic, since 4 February 2025), 6 months (the United States), 90 or 30 days; some only as tourists and some within a year (the footnotes' marks are lost in the copy, not modelled). Everyone else needs a visa; a stay on a Schengen, Canadian, UK or US visa for Honduras and some European nationals isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
